seo.title: Wimbledon: genAI editorial content (IBM watsonx) - engagement +16% in 2025
seo.meta_description: Wimbledon generates player summaries and highlight commentary via IBM watsonx.ai; the AELTC reports +16% engagement and +39% myWIMBLEDON registrations.
seo.resume_citable: Wimbledon uses IBM watsonx.ai to generate player summaries (Catch Me Up) and audio commentary on highlights in the tournament's editorial tone: in 2025 the AELTC reports a 16 percent rise in engagement across all platforms and 39 percent growth in myWIMBLEDON registrations.

faq.q: What does Wimbledon's AI generate for fans?
faq.a: Personalized summaries for each singles player (Catch Me Up) and audio commentary on highlight reels, produced by watsonx.ai in the tournament's editorial tone.
The AELTC reports in 2025 a 16 percent rise in engagement across all platforms and 39 percent growth in myWIMBLEDON registrations year-on-year.

pattern: editorial content generated by genAI in the brand voice for fan engagement
objectif_business: Retain and deepen the engagement of a global audience during and around the tournament by delivering personalized content and automatically generated narratives, without expanding the editorial team for every match.
points_cles: Catch Me Up player summaries and audio commentary on highlights generated by AI.
IBM watsonx.ai and watsonx.data, model tuned on the tournament's editorial tone.
Plus 16 percent engagement across all platforms and plus 39 percent myWIMBLEDON registrations in 2025.
Evidence level B, confirmed active status.
description: On the Wimbledon app and on wimbledon.com, the Catch Me Up feature generates summaries for each singles player: what happened in their last match and what is at stake in the next. The fan personalizes their list by adding favorite players. Fans can also add AI-generated audio commentary to highlight reels, with narration at the start and end of the reel and on key points. The content is produced by IBM watsonx.ai, a model tuned on trusted Wimbledon data and trained to write in the tournament's editorial style and tone. Structured and unstructured data are managed by watsonx.data on an open lakehouse architecture, accessible to applications across the club's hybrid cloud. These capabilities add to the Likelihood to Win feature, which continuously computes each player's probability of winning.

resultats.metrique: Rise in engagement across all platforms (2025, year-on-year)
Tournament digital impressions, around 730 million people reached

niveau_preuve.justification: Quantified platform case study (IBM watsonx), corroborated by an IBM/AELTC press release and by the business press (Fortune), which name Wimbledon and the engagement gains reported by the AELTC. Engagement figures reported by the brand through its partner, hence B rather than A.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Near real time during the tournament: player summaries and highlight commentary regenerate as matches and results come in.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: AELTC digital and editorial team, with IBM Consulting for model operation and editorial oversight.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: Structured match data and Wimbledon history. If the supply of trusted data or the tuning on the editorial tone is missing, the generated content drifts from the brand style or produces factual errors.

etapes.detail: watsonx.data centralizes structured and unstructured tournament data on an open lakehouse architecture.
watsonx.ai, tuned on Wimbledon data and tone, writes the Catch Me Up summaries and the highlight narration.
The editorial team validates adherence to the style and factual accuracy before publication.
The fan receives their summaries based on the players followed, on the app and the site.

statut_vivant.note: The IBM-Wimbledon partnership is renewed and expanded for the 2026 edition (new features, modernized digital platforms). The genAI program has been in production over several consecutive editions.

transposable_ue.note: Wimbledon is a British event, the audience is global. The pattern (editorial content generated by AI from proprietary data, in the brand voice) is directly transposable to the EU: IBM watsonx is available in European regions. Points of attention under the AI Act and GDPR: data governance, model traceability, and informing the audience about AI-generated content.
